## Checklist

- [ ] `gofmt` / `go vet` clean (Go changes)
- [ ] Unit tests added or updated
- [ ] Integration tests added or updated (mock server, no live credentials required)
- [ ] Race detector run for concurrency-affecting changes
- [ ] Security impact assessed; threat model updated if a trust boundary changed
- [ ] Public interfaces unchanged, or change recorded in an ADR
- [ ] Documentation updated (module README, tool reference, ADR)
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, customer data, or production fixtures committed
- [ ] Changelog entry added for user-visible changes
- [ ] Commits signed off (`git commit -s`) per the DCO
